title: Opus 5.5 Graphical Adventure Game (Sierra Style)
author: rgrivera1113
selftext:
I took Opus 5.5 out for a spin last weekend and had it one shot a Sierra style adventure game. It took about 30 minutes to build and all graphics are built programatically.

It's not as impressive as some of the other one-shotters that have been posted since 5.5 dropped. But it's a complete game and brings back good memories of my old Tandy.

comments.author: Foreign-Quote-53
comments.body: I mean to me this is a lot more interesting than a lot of the other “one shots”. Feels more unique and has a more interesting/unique style

replies.author: Foreign-Quote-53
replies.body: Certainly needs to be longer and probably have some kind of added element or unique element to separate it from just a shallow pastiche. But I think it’s a great start.

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: Agreed. One shots are great for getting a basic idea out so that you can see what it feels and looks like. the real strength come from iterating on that and building off of it. Like working with clay. You start with a block or a vague shape and you start refining it and shaping it into what you want.

replies.author: rgrivera1113
replies.body: I was thinking about it. It shouldn't be that big of a lift to turn it into an engine and make it more authorable. This would be the fifth project on the list. It's going to be a while before I do anything significant with it.

replies.author: rgrivera1113
replies.body: It was something like, "Make a Sierra style adventure game with a pixel art style. Use a point and click interface."

replies.author: xiraov
replies.body: Oh really minimal. Is it an html file?
